components.observation: RGB display patterns and backlight checked visually.
Stock touch pattern and two-finger photo zoom completed.
Physical key test and ordinary screen sleep/wake completed.
Physical buttons responded in the stock key test.
Switch down opened Essentials; switch up returned Home.
Rear 1x focus, photo capture and saved-photo reopening worked.
Rear 0.6x wider view, photo capture and reopening worked.
Front preview, photo capture and reopening worked.
Recorded speech and both stock microphone loopbacks worked.
Video audio, both speaker melody tests and receiver test worked.
Association with an access point and internet traffic worked.
Audio played through a paired Bluetooth headset.
Battery level rose from 92% to 97% over 8.1 minutes of wired charging.
A 4096-byte file was written and read back over USB ADB with identical SHA-256; its exact phone copy was deleted and absence verified.
Synthetic file create/read/delete and camera photo save/reopen worked.
components.evidence_method: USB ADB commands and operator observation on stock

components.observation: Stock fingerprint setup and enrolled-finger unlocking worked.
Vibration was perceptible during the stock test.
An NFC security-key tag was read and its associated webpage opened.
An ordinary stock call and SMS messaging worked.

limits: Basic stock observations on the stated handset model and build.
Wi-Fi internet, Bluetooth headset audio, NFC tag interaction, call and SMS were operator-observed; individual radio bands, codecs, ranges and carrier scenarios were not fully qualified.
USB transfer used ADB; MTP and other USB modes were not separately qualified.
Measured camera/performance/battery baselines and custom-OS qualification are separate work.
Bootloader unlock, relock and stock restoration were not tested or approved by this report.
